description: Land Acquisition - Morawatta, Ruwanwella D/S Division Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire specific parcels of land for public purpose. It provides descriptions of the lands, including lot numbers, names, claimants, and extents, and outlines procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters.
